newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse turnover boosted by special boards.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse turnover boosted by special boards.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) was boosted on Tuesday by foreign activity on the special boards, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 33.4 million shares traded on 729,800 shares from 22 million shillings on 441,790 shares on Monday.
The index shed 13.33 points to close at 3457.88.
Foreign investors traded 100,000 shares of Firestone East Africa at a reserve price of 33 from 29 on the three-day special offer board and 90,000 shares of Uchumi Supermarket at 40 from 37.
Brokers said now that results -- both year-end and interim -- had started trickling in, activity could pick up on speculative trading.
A bourse official added: "Prices will continue easing until they enter a range where it will be convenient to buy for short term speculative reasons."
Brooke Bond eased to 123 from 124 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 10. Kenya Airways closed at 8.25 unchanged while Nation Printers & Publishers gained eight shillings to close at 110.
Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 101 from 104 while Barclays Bank closed at 109 from 112. Standard Chartered Bank was unchanged at 50.
Kenya Power & Lighting traded at 175 from 174 while Total Kenya was unchanged at 65.50.
The fourth issue of the Central Bank of Kenya floating-rate treasury bond traded 11.65 million shillings at 101.75 percent from 101.7124 percent.
